population: HAALSI target pooled cleaned capillary point-of-care glucose context; adults age >=40 years, no upper age limit; whole-cohort synthesis.

definition_basis.basis: Reviewed official variable definitions and sex value-label metadata only; no target outcomes or composition supplied.

age.definition: Census age on 31 July 2014 at sample selection; not interview-date age
age.locator: Codebook p13; survey/variables DOCX zero-based table42 row18

sex.basis: Actual-file value-label metadata independently verified; census-preloaded sex; no category frequencies supplied
sex.locator: Definition codebook p95; DOCX table42 row20; reviewed selected value-label dictionary

bmi.definition: BMI derived from cleaned height and weight
bmi.unit_basis: Conventional BMI unit interpretation from documented height cm and weight kg; actual BMI label has no explicit unit string

glucose.definition: Released cleaned point-of-care glucose from CareSens readings/checks and comments; fingerstick/capillary protocol context
glucose.fasting: Pooled protocol; fasting status is not an eligibility requirement
glucose.feeding_mixture: unspecified; no target proportions or dependencies supplied

reference_selection.native_and_tagged_missing: excluded from the measured reference subset; no imputation
reference_selection.unknown_nonmissing_sex_or_bad_numeric_dt: fail input validation rather than silently coercing
reference_selection.sentinel_qualification: None identified in reviewed metadata; not a claim of physical absence. Range-flag cutoffs are not sentinel lists.

transport_limits: Recorded cleaned boundary/substitution values do not become exact latent biological measurements.
Source serum assays, repeated glucose averaging, fasting rules, health exclusions, imputation and age eligibility do not become target rules.
Unknown target demographic, feeding and treatment mixture is not reconstructed from reference data; construction assumptions belong to the Agent.
